exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix label-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --priority 0 --label team,ready,paused,phase:a 'paused high priority'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-first.txt
exec card create --priority 1 --label team,ready,phase:a 'first eligible'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-second.txt
exec card create --priority 1 --label team,ready,phase:b 'second eligible'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-third.txt
exec card create --priority 0 --label team,phase:b 'missing required label'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-fourth.txt
exec card create --priority 2 --label team,ready,phase:c 'no alternative label'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-fifth.txt

# List requires every positive term and excludes every negative term.
exec card list --status ready --label team --label ready --label -paused --limit 0
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list.txt

# Automatic claim applies the same all/none groups plus one any-of group
# without changing priority and creation order.
exec card --actor geordi claim --label team --label ready --label -paused --label-any phase:b --label-any phase:a
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim.txt

# Every automatic selector is invalid with a direct issue ID.
! exec card --actor data claim label-3 --under label-1
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/direct-selector-error.txt
! exec card --actor data claim label-3 --label -paused
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/direct-selector-error.txt
! exec card --actor data claim label-3 --label-any phase:b
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/direct-selector-error.txt
! exec card --actor data claim label-3 --watch
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/direct-selector-error.txt

-- golden/create-first.txt --
label-1
-- golden/create-second.txt --
label-2
-- golden/create-third.txt --
label-3
-- golden/create-fourth.txt --
label-4
-- golden/create-fifth.txt --
label-5
-- golden/list.txt --
ID       PRI  STATUS  TYPE  TITLE
label-2  1    ready   task  first eligible
label-3  1    ready   task  second eligible
label-5  2    ready   task  no alternative label
-- golden/claim.txt --
Claimed label-2 as geordi.
Issue label-2
Title: first eligible
Type: task
Status: in_progress
Priority: 1
Assignee: geordi
Labels: phase:a, ready, team
-- golden/direct-selector-error.txt --
error: --under, --label, --label-any, and --watch require automatic claim selection without an ID
